newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes stable, MDO/gas oil weak.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes stable, MDO/gas oil weak.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around their recent levels on Friday with poor demand while MDO and gas oil continued their downtrend, traders said.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $97/$98 per tonne by majors while independents were offering $2/$3 per tonne lower.

"People are concerned that there will be no demand, so some try to grab business with low prices," said one trader. "Sentiment is still quite bearish," said one major, adding that prices would continued to be flat.
MDO and gas oil were quoted lower to $180 and $190 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
